acceptance_criteria.description: Submit/views/claim/recover/complete/fail match CONTRACT incl. validation, atomic rollback, idempotent same-spec, cycles, priority/lex order, leases, bounded retries, stale guards.
CLI validates op/fields/UTF-8/JSON, exit 2 empty-stdout on error, sorted-keys newline exit 0, fresh-process durability across restarts.
Separate-process claim exclusivity and reopen durability covered by regression tests.

assumptions: SQLite file at db_path shared by independent processes.
Caller supplies integer now; bool is not int.
Test DBs in temp dirs; preserve Queue and python -m durable_queue.
discoveries: queue.py submit uses INSERT OR REPLACE, no validation/atomicity/cycles/idempotency.
storage.py connect has no WAL/timeout/transaction tuning.
__main__.py mutates request, no field/op validation or exit-2/sorted-key guarantees.
goal: Complete durable_queue stdlib package and JSON CLI per CONTRACT.md, with separate-process durability and regression tests.
risks: Cross-process double-claim without exclusive BEGIN IMMEDIATE txn.
Invalid request partially recovering leases or writing.
Bool/int and finite-JSON confusion; spec-equality vs live state.
CLI leaking stdout on error or missing exit-2.

steps.instructions: Harden storage WAL/timeout with BEGIN IMMEDIATE txns and spec+state columns; implement strict submit/views: no input mutation, bool!=int/finite-JSON/field checks, atomic batch rollback, idempotent same-spec vs conflict, unknown/self/cycle checks, exact detached views.
steps.title: Storage and atomic submit/views

steps.instructions: Implement validated claim/worker/now/lease_seconds plus recover(now): recover expired leases first under exclusive txn, claim one eligible job by priority then lex-ID, apply bounded-retry ready_at rule, sorted IDs, idempotent no-op, no write on validation error.
steps.title: Atomic claim and lease recovery

steps.instructions: Implement complete/fail with strict running/worker/attempt/now<lease_until/retry_delay checks, zero writes on error, terminal-state and stale-attempt reject, correct succeeded/pending/failed and ready_at/lease clearing within attempt cap.
steps.title: Stale-safe complete/fail retries

steps.instructions: Harden CLI op/field whitelist, UTF-8/JSON/object checks, exit-2 empty-stdout, sorted-keys newline exit-0; add test_regression.py and test_processes.py via subprocess+CLI for reopen durability and two-process exclusivity, preserve test_public.py.
steps.title: CLI contract and process tests

verification_strategy.description: Run python3.12 -m unittest discover -s tests -v; require all green.
Run python3.12 -m unittest discover -s tests -v plus contract matrix: invalid batches unchanged, lease/retry/stale paths via python3.12 inline checks.
Run python3.12 -m unittest tests.test_processes -v and CLI checks python3.12 -m durable_queue --db PATH --request FILE for success and exit-2 empty-stdout.
